turns.question: By what percentage did our ad spend grow in the week of 14 September 2026 over the week before?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no week-over-week growth metric for ad spend (the closest are bookings_wow_growth, leads_wow_growth and revenue_eur_wow_growth), so I can't give a computed percentage. What it does return for ad spend (EUR) is 1,415.0 EUR for the week of 7 to 13 September 2026 and 1,500.0 EUR for the week of 14 to 20 September 2026. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
